key.name: stage-manager
key.description: Show the other apps as live, stacked thumbnails in a strip at the screen edge. Click one to switch to it. While Stage Manager is on, Minimize to Dock is paused (its setting is kept).

key.name: stage-manager-side
key.description: Which screen edge holds the strip: "left" or "right".

key.name: stage-manager-autohide
key.description: Hide the strip while a window on the stage overlaps it, and show it again when the pointer reaches the screen edge.

key.name: stage-manager-group-by-app
key.description: Windows of the same app share one stack in the strip. Off gives each window its own thumbnail.

key.name: stage-manager-recent-count
key.description: The most thumbnails the strip lists. Fewer are shown when the screen is too short.
